question: 店里到现在一共成交了多少笔订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order
note: 单表 COUNT 聚合，最基础口径

question: 所有订单的销量加起来一共有多少件？

note: 单表 SUM 聚合，度量=order_quantity

question: 一共有多少个客户下过单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM fact_order

question: 单笔金额超过一千块的订单有多少笔？

question: 一次买超过两件的订单都有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_quantity FROM fact_order WHERE order_quantity > 2

gold_sqls: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_quantity FROM fact_order WHERE order_quantity > 2

question: 那些金额不到50块的小额订单，总共卖了多少钱？

question: 每个客户各下了多少笔单？按下单数从多到少给我排一下
gold_sql: SELECT dc.customer_id, dc.customer_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id GROUP BY dc.customer_id, dc.customer_name ORDER BY order_count DESC
note: 2026-10-15 修订：原 gold 只 SELECT customer_id，标注过严（模型返回 id+name 更贴合口语'每个客户'），改为含客户名版本

question: 各个会员等级分别有多少客户？人数多的排前面

question: 2025年2月比1月的销售额多了多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 2 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 1 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_diff FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025
note: 跨期对比：条件聚合求差（允许两子查询相减的等价写法）（补 gold 变体：模型常返回 1月额/2月额/差额 三列，与单列差额等价）
gold_sqls: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 2 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 1 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_diff FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 1 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS jan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 2 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS feb_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 2 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 1 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_diff FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 2 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS feb_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 1 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS jan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 2 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN dd.month = 1 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_diff FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025
